reviewer: Codex; individual rule and graph review, not human expert certification
method: Primary pages opened with web tools during this audit. These notes are paraphrases, not a claim of archived full-source receipts.

sources.application: Class seniority and modern principal-chain length before unsaturation. P-41 explicitly illustrates 3-hydroxypropanamide and 4-oxobutanenitrile.
Permitted locant omissions, ordered numbering criteria and prefix citation. General systematic names and preferred names must not be conflated.
Hydrocarbon roots and parent identity; no claim of independent expected text for every generated graph.
Amines, carbonyls, acids and subordinate prefixes; 3-oxobutanoic acid is a printed example in P-64.5 and P-65.
Nitrogen functions, amide N substitution, nitriles; linked P-62 rules apply to substituted amines.
Historical unsaturated-chain selection and placement of unsaturation locants. Unlike 2013, unsaturation controls parent selection before chain length.
Independent name-to-structure parser; English output receipts are captured separately with exact URLs, raw bodies and SHA-256. Parsing does not adjudicate PIN or 1979 preference.

limits: No newly generated Spanish text is promoted to an exact normative reference by translation.
No fresh PubChem cross-check is claimed.
Production group detection is reused; applying the published seniority order to its output does not independently validate the detector.
The corpus's independently reviewed existing expectations and frozen receipts remain separate and unmodified.
